utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible—let’s pick a time, make the fix-it list, and see who can bring tools. Once we’ve got that, Faye can decide if she can make it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday afternoon at the community shed still works best. I’ll sort the donated tools and help sign folks in, and once the time’s set, Uli can let Faye know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday afternoon works for me. Let’s keep it simple, and once Uli tells Faye, we’ll see who can come.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting out the timing for the repair drive. Once I know the day, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s on Sunday at the community center. Once Mara’s quick check is ready, send me the home list and I’ll pass it to Leo.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll share it once I’ve got Mara’s quick check.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you tell me exactly what the repair drive needs and when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy, but we need screwdrivers, a hammer, duct tape, an extension cord, and maybe a folding chair if I can find one. Vik’s keeping everyone posted on the details and start time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — please have Vik send the exact start time and list, and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few extra tools for the repair drive. If you need anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — that’d be great. I’m pretty sure it’s still Sunday at the community center, but if I think of anything specific I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just send me any specifics, and I’ll bring what I can on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive and sort the tools later. I’ll stop by when I can so Quinn can fill me in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — if I hear anything else about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along. Gus is still setting the drop-off window, and Oren’s bringing a toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. I’ll check in with Quinn when I stop by and be ready to sort the tools later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still need the timing for the repair drive first—Uli’s sorting that out. Once we know it, I can line things up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s set for Saturday afternoon at the community shed. I’m gathering tape, screws, glue, batteries, and a few tools—Hana can help, Bo can bring a basic toolkit and gloves, and Tess will spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Saturday afternoon works. I’ll line things up, and Rey can help with the drive too—Eli will bring a notepad for the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep the repair drive updates moving, and Ira and Dane can help spread any news too. Oren’s bringing a good stash of tools, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — Saturday afternoon at the community shed should work, as long as everyone knows where to go. Once that’s settled, please fill Rey in too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let Rey know about Saturday afternoon at the community shed, and keep the repair drive updates moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring a basic toolkit and gloves for the repair drive. Rey can sort the tools first, and then we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, that covers the tools. We’re still gathering the usual neighborhood fixes too—anything broken, loose, or just needing a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for anything quick we can fix. If you hear about more volunteers or extra tools, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — if you hear anything, please spread the word. I know Ira will pass along repair-drive news right away, and Opal’s checking for volunteers and tools too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word, and it’s set for Sunday at the community center. With Leo, Gus, Mara, Eli, and Sam helping, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great — Sunday at the community center should work well. Thanks for spreading the word, Jules.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll ask around for volunteers and see who can bring tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Opal. I’ll bring tape, glue, and a few screws, and I can help sort the other supplies at the shed on Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana — the shed on Saturday afternoon works for me. I’ll keep asking around and see who else can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m here to lend a hand, and I’ll make sure Gus brings that toolbox. I’ll keep an eye out for your quick check too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. I’ll get the homes list ready and flag any urgent fixes I spot before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — once your quick check is ready, Rosa’ll send the home list over to Leo. Faye’s still waiting on the repair drive timing, but she’ll fit it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring the screwdriver set and spare batteries on Saturday afternoon at the community shed. I’ll also check who’s still waiting for help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’ve got the screwdriver set and spare batteries covered for Saturday afternoon at the community shed, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, that’s covered. I’ll bring the screwdriver set and spare batteries on Saturday afternoon at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep that in mind and help sort the supplies too. Let me know if you hear anything about the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for the list and make sure Rey gets the tools sorted before we start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, and I’ll keep sorting the other supplies with Hana’s tape, glue, and screws. If you hear anything about the list, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got my toolbox ready if anyone needs it. Just let me know the timing and drop-off details, and I can swing by to help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — I’ll bring my screwdriver, duct tape, hammer, and an extension cord, and I’ll pitch in wherever needed. If I can find the folding chair, I’ll grab that too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds great, Oren — we’ve got a solid little kit going. Just send me the timing and drop-off details when they’re set, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard Oren’s bringing a toolbox and some extra gear, and Gus should set a clear drop-off window. If I hear anything else on the repair drive, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that helps. I’ll bring a notepad so we can list the fixes, set a time, and see who can bring what tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — it’s Saturday afternoon at the community shed, and I’ll bring tape, glue, and a few screws. I can help sort the other supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Hana — that helps a lot. I’ll spread the word to Ira and Dane, and we’ll get the rest lined up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies list and sort the rest when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — a basic toolkit and gloves would help a lot. I still need the repair drive timing before I can say more about the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring the toolkit and gloves. Just let me know the repair drive timing when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the timing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep spreading the word so folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate you spreading the word. Once Mara sends me the home list, I’ll pass it to Leo so he can check who’s still waiting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — once Mara sends it over, that’ll help Leo know where to start. I’ll keep letting folks know it’s this Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard the repair drive still needs volunteers and a few tools. Ira said they’d pass along any updates right away, and Opal was going to check if anyone can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — that’s helpful. I’ll keep my list of homes and urgent fixes ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep listening for any updates from Ira and let you know if I hear more about volunteers or tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday afternoon at the community shed still works for me, as long as the drop-off window is clear. Once that’s settled, we can let Faye know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll ask around for volunteers and see if anyone else can bring tools for the repair drive. Gus and Bo already have the tools side covered, so I’ll help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good — as long as Gus sets a clear drop-off window, I’m comfortable with Saturday afternoon at the community shed. If there’s still a gap, Oren and Cleo’s supplies should cover most of it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s set for Saturday afternoon at the community shed. I’m still gathering tape, screws, glue, batteries, and a few basic tools for it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday afternoon at the community shed to help sort the donated tools and sign people in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Sam — that helps a lot. I’ll keep pulling the supplies together and let the others know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I’ll let you know when Uli finishes sorting the timing and we need your help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — once the timing’s set, I’ll be there, and I’ll make sure Gus brings that toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you — I’ll pass it along as soon as Uli confirms the timing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone handy with small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a big help. I can sort the tools later and stop by to get the latest from Quinn and Opal.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, Sunday at the community center — got it. I’ll keep an eye out and tell Jules if I think of anyone handy with small-appliance repair.
